title: Dr Frost Arctic Strawmelon Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Nic Salt Strawmelon Ice blends notes that are both familiar and exotic into one irresistible combination. You’ll experience the soft, summery succulence of perfectly ripe strawberries on the inhale, enhanced by the lush, delicate sweetness of juicy watermelon. And for maximum refreshment, a subtle layer of crisp menthol adds a note-perfect hint of crushed ice that truly takes this classic fruit combo to the next level. Crafted as part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated Bar Salts flavour to deliver the same bold, intense taste vapers enjoy in disposable vapes. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it is designed for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits and low-powered devices, providing smooth throat hits and fast nicotine relief. Available in 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Strawmelon Ice offers a versatile and satisfying option for adult smokers and vapers seeking bold flavours and icy refreshment.
